topic: How does the 45° scan range affect link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users compared to broadside beams?
consensus_response: The 45° scan range introduces scan losses, beam squint, and polarization mismatch, degrading SNR and signal quality. Designers must account for these effects through precise antenna modeling and compensation techniques, such as dual-polarized antennas and adaptive beamforming, to maintain performance margins for edge users.
reference_context: SatCom systems experience reduced antenna gain and increased interference at 45° scan range, impacting link budget calculations and QoS.
